data.problem: Subagent tool calls (mcp_opencode_task/task) are not visibly updating in the TUI because the parent session only renders its own ToolParts and Task metadata does not reliably propagate for MCP tool execution.
constraints: Explore phase only: no code changes or implementation plans
TUI renders from sync store (message/part events)
Subagent work occurs in child sessions (parentID)

options.name: Restore Task metadata propagation for MCP tools
options.approach: Validate tool_use_id/callID availability in MCP handlers and ensure Task tool metadata (summary/sessionId) is merged into tool_use_summary/tool-result metadata so the Task UI receives updates.
options.what_we_learn: Whether missing metadata is the root cause for absent subagent updates in TUI; exact place metadata is dropped.
options.risk_if_wrong: Low; investigation is localized to provider/native stream/bridge.

options.name: TUI-side child session mirroring
options.approach: When Task tool has metadata.sessionId, have the TUI sync that child session and render its tool parts inline or in an expandable panel.
options.what_we_learn: Whether rendering child session parts directly yields the desired visibility without server changes.
options.risk_if_wrong: Medium; multi-session data flow and UI performance concerns.

options.name: Server-side aggregation of subagent tool progress
options.approach: Add a parent-session summary stream that mirrors child tool updates into the Task tool metadata (or a new event), avoiding TUI multi-session rendering.
options.what_we_learn: Feasibility of a centralized progress feed and whether it simplifies UI.

data.recommendation: Option 1 because it is the fastest path to validate whether metadata propagation is the blocker for subagent tool visibility, and it keeps changes localized to the MCP tool bridge/stream layer.
